title: Phase 6 physical economics: computed terms, structural refusals

categories.name: actual_duration
categories.notes: measured wall duration of the load window: 2.5734s for 512 verified outcomes (5.026172 ms/outcome); includes model load / Metal graph compile (cold-start dilution named in energy receipt error_notes)

categories.name: utilization
categories.would_require: a production utilization signal on MeasuredCellCost (busy fraction of the placement over the billable window), not a default of 1.0
categories.notes: absent today — no production utilization meter on MeasuredCellCost or the energy harness

categories.name: provider_supplier_rate
categories.notes: cloud provider hourly rate is not applicable on owned Metal. Supplier catalogue entitlement is a separate money-path term (see supplier_contribution); it is not a cloud provider rate. No CUDA provider rate is invented on this host.

categories.name: startup_and_residency
categories.would_require: separate cold-start amortization (model load, graph compile, warm-resident replica $/hr allocation) measured and attributed per verified outcome
categories.notes: energy load window includes cold start but no startup/residency money model is attributed

categories.name: verification
categories.would_require: Merc verification_outcome rollup (samples/fails) for the same unit of work; energy harness uses n_predict completion tokens as the outcome unit, not job verification passes
categories.notes: token count is not verification pass-rate; cannot scale cost by samples/passes on this path

categories.name: retries
categories.would_require: task.retry_count rollup on the same workload (RetryRate on MeasuredCellCost)
categories.notes: energy harness is a single llama-cli invocation; no retry observations

categories.name: storage_and_egress
categories.would_require: accepted/actual storage and egress bytes bound into a PricingDecision CostSchedule model for this unit of work
categories.notes: CostSchedule publishes defaulted AWS rates with provenance (control/cost_schedule.go) but this Metal energy path has no attributed bytes; rates without bytes are not a cost

categories.name: payment_allocation
categories.would_require: processor fee allocation from EconomicSchedule against a real buyer charge for this outcome
categories.notes: energy path has no buyer charge; money-path processor fee is modeled only when settlement runs

categories.name: energy
categories.notes: BOUND GPU-domain energy: 0.121724572 J/verified_outcome (IOReport); dollar conversion uses defaulted $0.15/kWh (control/pricing.go) and is partial only

categories.name: refund_risk
categories.would_require: measured refund/dispute cohort rate for the product surface, or an accrued risk-reserve settlement tied to this outcome with release/consume ledger proof
categories.notes: CostSchedule risk reserve is a 50 bps policy model (defaulted), not a measured loss rate; policy alone does not make refund risk KNOWN for Phase 6 physical cost

joules_per_verified_outcome.basis: IOReport GPU Energy channel (AGX on-chip domain only); BOUND measured_energy_authority; 512 completion_tokens over load_window; not package, not wall-plug

cost_per_verified_outcome.reason: full physical cost per verified outcome requires every directive category; only GPU-domain energy is measured on this path — see energy_usd_per_verified_outcome_partial for the partial dollar figure

energy_usd_per_verified_outcome_partial.basis: GPU-domain joules (0.121724572 J) × defaulted electricity $0.15/kWh; NOT full cost_per_verified_outcome; package/CPU/DRAM/ANE/startup/storage/payment/refund excluded

unavailable.reason: buyer savings is a counterfactual (external price − Merc price); no bound external list price or measured alternative invoice exists in-repo; deriving savings from an unvalidated catalogue list price is refused

available.basis: exact supplier ledger credit for 128 deliveries / 1 physical execution(s); money conservation: buyer charge = supplier credit + platform row; not the supplier's physical cost stack

physical_cost_of_supplier.reason: Merc credits catalogue entitlement; supplier energy, depreciation, and residency are the supplier's cost and are not metered into Merc's books on community/owned supply

unavailable.reason: true net contribution remains structurally unavailable while any named directive cost category is UNKNOWN or ASSUMED rather than being presented as profit

gross_platform_ledger_row.label: gross_platform_ledger_row_not_true_net
gross_platform_ledger_row.basis: buyer_charge_nanos_total − supplier_payable_nanos_total on the 128→1 reuse money path; equals KnownCostContributionNanos / ledger platform residual. Processor, storage, egress, energy, and refund risk are not fully attributed on this path — this is gross contribution, never true net.
gross_platform_ledger_row.not_true_net: anti-gaming law: a gross platform ledger row must never be presented as Merc true net contribution

unavailable.reason: primary metric requires verified outcomes, full dollar cost per outcome, joules per outcome, and inside-SLA; dollar cost and SLA are incomplete today — refusing to quote a number that drops those terms

term_status.verified_outcomes: KNOWN count on energy path (512 completion_tokens) and money path (128 deliveries); unit differs by path
term_status.dollar_cost_per_outcome: UNAVAILABLE — full cost_per_verified_outcome blocked by unknown directive categories (partial energy-only USD must not substitute)
term_status.inside_sla: UNAVAILABLE — no SLA bound (MaxDurationMsPerUnit / contract SLA) evaluated on the energy harness

honest_summary: Merc true net contribution is not computable today. Joules per verified outcome are BOUND for GPU-domain Metal (0.1217 J). Full cost per verified outcome is blocked by unknown categories. Buyer savings has no counterfactual price. Supplier contribution is known only as ledger entitlement on the money path. The primary metric (outcomes per dollar per joule inside SLA) is not quotable: dollar cost and SLA are incomplete. Gross platform ledger rows exist and must not be labeled true net.

scope.placement: local Apple M3 Ultra / llama.cpp Metal (owned supply); money path from public reuse conservation receipt
scope.energy_boundary: IOReport Energy Model channel 'GPU Energy' (AGX on-chip GPU domain only)
energy_excludes: CUDA / NVIDIA (no device on this host)
scope.pricing_decision_true_net_distinction: PricingDecision.FixedPoint.TrueNetContributionNanos is settlement-ledger contribution after modeled PricingDecision components only; it is not the Phase 6 directive physical true net and must not be quoted as such while directive categories remain UNKNOWN
